name: Mall Solid Wall
summary: A 1.2 m modular solid wall with limestone-coloured panels and dark skirting.
description: A 3 m high original architectural wall module aligned to the existing mall floor and ceiling grid.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender geometry and Principled materials; no external models or textures.

assembly.origin: bottom centre; Blender +Z / glTF +Y up, front glTF +Z
assembly.connectors: x = -0.6 and +0.6 m; place successive roots 1.2 m apart

rights: Original geometry and materials created for the owner project. Public redistribution terms not specified.
accuracy_notes: Visual modular wall only. No structural, fire, acoustic, accessibility or construction certification.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials created for Blender-3D-Gallery.

quality_gate.scope: Static exported geometry and local preview only; no physical device, full assembly collision or construction assessment.
